name: How much does a stone retaining wall typically cost to install?

mainEntity.name: How much does a stone retaining wall typically cost to install?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a stone retaining wall varies widely based on several factors, including the type of stone, the wall's height and length, site accessibility, and necessary drainage solutions. Natural stone can be more expensive than engineered block. Complex designs, extensive excavation, or difficult access can also increase labor costs. We provide detailed, itemized quotes after a site assessment to ensure accuracy, covering materials, labor, and any required permits.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for stone retaining walls vary based on stone type, wall size, site complexity, and drainage needs. A site assessment provides an accurate quote.
